name: orgchart
description: Build and display interactive organizational charts, editable via a drag-and-drop builder or a YAML editor, and render them in a block.
project_description:
Responsive Drag and Drop Organizational Charts or Diagrams, using jQuery UI Draggable and Droppable.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Drag and Drop UI 
 Supports up to 3 css media queries (desktop/tablet/phone) 
 Supports multiple Organizational Charts 
 Display Organizational Charts in a page or a block 
 Organizational Charts are saved as configs and can be exported/imported 
 YAML code editor 
 Customisable colors and style
